verdict.rationale: Maritime documents provisioning a separate agent micro-VM for every end user through its SDK, which amounts to a fleet. Its only documented limits are plan-based agent counts (free plan includes 3 agents; subscriptions carry "a set number of agents"), not concurrency limits or scale figures. missing for 10: documented concurrent-run limits or quotas, evidence of running large fleets at scale, rate limits for provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet performance.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: Give every one of your users their own agent with the TypeScript or Python SDK.
provision is idempotent on it: it returns the existing agent if there is one, else creates a new one. Safe to call on every sign-in.
the free plan includes 3 agents, no card required
One subscription, a set number of agents, flat prices for extras.
